world.setting: Chester's Mill, a small Maine town sealed under an invisible dome, with a riot at Food City, the town office, the hospital and the highway edge
world.register: small-town horror: a community turning on itself under pressure

jim.name: Big Jim Rennie
jim.role: second selectman, used car salesman, the town's self-appointed strongman
jim.look: a heavy middle-aged man in a dark suit and tie, close-cropped gray hair, florid face, a gold baseball on his desk

barbie.name: Dale Barbara (Barbie)
barbie.role: Iraq war veteran, drifter, short-order cook, framed for murder
barbie.look: a lean man in his thirties, unshaven, in a worn olive army-surplus shirt and jeans, short dark hair

andy.name: Andy Sanders
andy.role: first selectman, the town's nominal leader, slow to act
andy.look: a tired middle-aged man in a rumpled brown suit, thinning sandy hair, pale and anxious

julia.name: Julia Shumway
julia.role: editor of the local newspaper, resists the town leadership
julia.look: a woman in her forties with shoulder-length auburn hair, practical blouse, a notebook in hand

junior.name: Junior Rennie
junior.role: Big Jim's unstable son, a young man with a grudge and a gun
junior.look: a young man in his twenties, skinny, messy dark hair, a grey hooded sweatshirt, restless eyes

rusty.name: Rusty Everett
rusty.role: physician's assistant at the hospital, keeps the town alive
rusty.look: a man in his fifties in blue hospital scrubs, grey beard, reading glasses on a cord

townOffice.look: the town office with a big desk, a gold baseball and framed town seals on the wall

foodCity.look: the Food City supermarket after the riot: busted shelves, spilled wine, glass everywhere

cell.look: a bare jail cell with a bunk and a steel door

hospital.look: the Chester's Mill hospital corridor, fluorescent light, a small generator-run ward

diner.look: a small-town diner counter where the short-order cook works

routeEdge.look: Route 119 running straight into the invisible wall of the Dome

sealedSky.look: an ordinary blue sky over the town, sealed by a dome that bends the light

signatureObjects.name: The Dome
signatureObjects.why: the invisible barrier that seals Chester's Mill: no shared icon shows a transparent dome cut into a town, so it must be drawn

spine.claim: A small town is sealed off from the world by an invisible wall, and its second selectman sees his chance.
Scarcity turns neighbours into a mob at Food City while Big Jim hands badges and guns to his own people.
Barbie is framed for the murders, and the crowd believes the town's leaders over the outsider.
The hospital and the town's resources are held back by greed, and the people who could stop it do nothing.
The town was a terrarium: sooner or later every one of us realises we are already living under a closed dome.
